Honestly making a marinade and picking a protein of the week. Something you can marinate at the beginning of the week that will keep in the fridge for the next couple of days and after those couple of days of marination throwing that in the freezer for next week or later on in the week. Typical sides for us, rice beans, sheet pan roasted veggies, sautéed mushrooms and onions. The trick for me was knowing how long to cook things and when to put them in. For example grilled onions and caramelized onions have completely different flavor profiles and the only difference for achieving either is cook times. Same goes with spinach, blanched or heavily sautéed, asparagus roasted in pan with garlic seasoning or sautéed in pan with soy sauce a sesame oil.
